name: Pavé Diamond Huggie U Hoops
description: Add new shapes to your ear stack with these square hoops. Handcrafted in 14k solid gold and set with diamonds. Mejuri's 14k Gold Handcrafted Pavé Diamond U Hoop Earrings bring a unique and elegant touch to any jewelry collection.
key_features: Our 14k gold pieces are made to last and perfect for everyday wear. Each piece is crafted from 90% recycled gold.
14k white gold pieces are finished with rhodium plating, giving them their signature color along with added shine and durability.
Our mined diamonds are responsibly sourced from suppliers who follow conflict-free and socially responsible practices.
